episodes.description: Update July, 17, 2026, these are original recordings from a few years back when I was actively navigating a cult. I decided to keep the original form to honor the past and not erase where i was at the time. I plan to start sharing more. while knowing planing and oing are different. I dont know whwhen or how often I will show up but when i do, it will be real every time. Original caption 2023-2025? Time is slippery. Wanna contact me? Email dideducationpodcast@gmail.com --- In this Episode I Dive Deeper into my Truth & My experiences. I share my journey to rediscovering my Innocence & personal power. I talk about the effects of trauma & dissociation. This episode is Raw, Real & Vulnerable!
